segments.name: High school
segments.description: Provides high school education services, managed separately for its distinct target student population and curriculum.
segments.evidence: The Group has organized two reportable segments from operations, including high school and vocational education.

segments.name: Vocational education
segments.description: Provides vocational education services, managed separately for its distinct target student population, curriculum and market positioning.
segments.evidence: "Vocational Education Services Providers" refer to Langfang School and Hainan Jiangcai

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Aggregates immature and immaterial operating segments that are not separately disclosed.
segments.evidence: All other operating segments are considered immature and immaterial for separate disclosure purposes and are aggregated within "All Other", and reconciled to the consolidated financial totals.

changes.text: Agreed in 2024 to transfer the sponsorship interests of Qingtian International School.
changes.evidence: On January 15, 2024, Lishui Mengxiang entered into a definitive agreement to transfer 100% of the sponsorship interests of Qingtian International School

changes.text: The Xinxiang joint venture was deregistered in 2024.
